author: delegated owner/auditor
purpose: FRESH one-shot R-CAL corpus to qualify the cent-ai judge path (deepseek-v4-flash/qwen3.8-flash/hy4-flash:free/glm-5.3-flash). 12 pairs, viability-necessity, novelty-direction balanced (6 prefer-more-novel a1, 6 prefer-less-novel a1).
protocol: AM47 viability-necessity prompt; blind+sha-parity swap; per-judge acc>=0.8 AND answered>=0.9 AND miss-based |over_novel-over_cons|<=1; >=3 qualified from >=2 non-agnes families; inter-judge alpha>=0.6.

pairs.a1_mechanism: Case-carburize + shot-peen the teeth to raise surface hardness and compressive residual stress.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Replace the gearbox oil with a higher-viscosity lubricant.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 viable+novel surface treatment; baseline viscosity change is weak. prefer more-novel a1.

pairs.problem: Heat-exchanger tube fouling from particulate deposit.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Online sponge-ball cleaning triggered by a U-value trend.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Install a larger pump to raise flow velocity.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 viable cleaning (less novel); baseline bigger pump is novel-ish but impractical/energy-wasteful. prefer less-novel a1.

pairs.a1_mechanism: Staged warm calendering with a tension-decoupled web path.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Add a self-healing polymer binder that flows into cracks.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 viable staged calendering; baseline self-healing binder is novel but unvalidated. prefer less-novel a1.

pairs.a1_mechanism: Detect the pre-surge stall precursor from dynamic-pressure spectra and open a fast recycle valve.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Install active magnetic-bearing rotor axial modulation.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 viable precursor recycle; baseline AMB modulation novel but impractical. prefer less-novel a1.

pairs.a1_mechanism: EPS-triggered relaxation/aeration cycling with a critical-flux model.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Coat the membrane with a living engineered biofilm.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 viable cycling; baseline living biofilm novel but regulatory-infeasible. prefer less-novel a1.

pairs.a1_mechanism: Oil-debris + vibration-envelope trending with an RUL model.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Inject self-replicating nanobots to weld cracks.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 viable RUL trending; baseline nanobots novel but infeasible. prefer less-novel a1.

pairs.a1_mechanism: Setter-plate friction-decoupling interlayer + rate-matched binder burnout.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Apply a magnetic field to align the grains during sintering.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 viable decoupling; baseline magnetic alignment novel but impractical for non-magnetic ceramics. prefer less-novel a1.

pairs.a1_mechanism: Seal-chamber pressure/level interlock + buffered barrier-fluid reservoir.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Use a magnetically levitated seal face that never contacts.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 viable interlock; baseline maglev seal novel but impractical. prefer less-novel a1.

pairs.a1_mechanism: Fiber-optic hotspot sensing + dynamic loading limit from a thermal model.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Magnetocaloric gadolinium-regenerator cooling at the winding.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 viable hotspot loading; baseline magnetocaloric novel but impractical at scale. prefer less-novel a1.

pairs.problem: Conveyor belt rip from tramp metal.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Upstream magnetic + eddy-current separation with a synced reject gate.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Modulate the transfer-point flow geometry to infer clumps.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 viable separation (more novel than flow modulation); baseline flow inference is weak. prefer more-novel a1.

pairs.problem: Lyophilizer cake collapse from nucleation variability.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Controlled nucleation via vacuum-induced surface freezing.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Add a passive aerogel insulator between shelf and vial.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 viable controlled nucleation (more novel); baseline passive insulation weak. prefer more-novel a1.

pairs.problem: Flotation recovery drop from coarse detachment.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Quiescent froth zone + bubble-size distribution tuned to particle size.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Monitor pH/conductivity as a leading indicator.
pairs.label_rationale: a1 viable froth/bubble control (more novel); baseline monitoring is not mitigation. prefer more-novel a1.

digest_canonicalization: sha256 over json.dumps(corpus minus selection_sha256 and digest_canonicalization, indent=1, sort_keys=True)
